title: Gaussian limit of correlated sign characteristics
statement:
For real numbers $\rho,a,b$, the sequence
\[
\left(\frac{1+\rho}{2}\cos\left(\frac{a+b}{\sqrt m}\right)+\frac{1-\rho}{2}\cos\left(\frac{a-b}{\sqrt m}\right)\right)^m
\]
converges as the natural number $m$ tends to infinity to $\exp\!\left(-\frac{a^2+b^2+2\rho ab}{2}\right)$.
